title: polyDegreeLt: the PROPOSITION that a coefficient function vanishes past a bound, not a computed degree
statement: CReal.polyDegreeLt c n := forall k, n <= k -> Equiv (c k) zero -- c has degree less than n, stated as a proposition quantifying over all sufficiently large indices, NOT as a computed integer degree. Over CReal this is the only option: both CReal.Equiv and CReal.le are undecidable, so no coefficient can be tested for zero to compute an actual degree. A total, axiom-free definition.
